_about: Measured with python-pptx from the Workforce Optimization sales deck (10 slides,
13.333 x 7.5 in), the only complete reference deck in the estate. Read-only source;
nothing here is copied from it but numbers. `reference_slides` is what the file
actually contains; `deck_slides` is what lint_deck.py holds a built deck to, keyed by
this anatomy's slide numbers (see references/deck-anatomy.md for the slot mapping).
Re-measure and rewrite this file if the reference deck changes; never append to it.
prstGeom roundRect adjustment values in the reference, as the radius in inches.
Everything structural sits at 0.04-0.18 in on a shape inches wide: it reads square
at slide scale. Only chips and vendor badges are real pills (adj 50000).
corner_radius.note: The builder draws structure with square corners and reserves the pill for chips and badges.

cover._about: Reference slide 1, on the Title-AI photo layout. The base has no dark photo layout, so the cover is drawn on a full-bleed ink ground at the same geometry.
cover.dropped: The tier line the reference carried on the lower block ('PROOF OF VALUE · ROLL-OUT · SCALING') — the owner asked for no tier line on the cover.

vertical_icons._about: Reference slide 3: one picture per card, centred in the card's blue panel.

image_slots._about: Reference slide 4: the two before/after pictures.

table_type._about: Reference slides 8-10. The builder's floors are set from these.

_about: Per anatomy slide: the most rounded shapes lint_deck.py accepts. Structure is
square; the allowance covers the pills (KPI chips, stat tiles, numeral badges,
vendor badges), so it scales with the spec where the pill count does.

2.note: up to three KPI chips; the two cards and the anchor strip are square

5.note: three stat tiles plus up to six numbered step badges

6.note: no peer in the reference — it was a quadrant of reference slide 5; the allowance is the four numeral badges plus headroom

7.note: one vendor badge per layer; the ladder panels themselves are square
